title: Can a wearer tell all 16 grey levels apart?
claim: The display page states 4-bit greyscale, 16 levels of green. Are all 16 levels distinguishable on the glasses?

evidence.note: All 16 grey steps in a test PNG looked distinct, seen once. QR sideload, firmware not recorded. The same project finds the five text brightness levels (textColor 0-4) look alike: https://github.com/maticsh/matic-even/blob/main/docs/findings/display.md#h2
